text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(There are some things words cannot capture.
Things that can never be conveyed. But—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Taaryaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (The spirit riding the sand tells me! This is Tarumae's heart. And...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hochaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(These are Acute-san's feelings.
The emotions she's carried with her across all these years of running!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(These are... the true faces of two rivals
clashing at the pinnacle of dirt racing!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah....
Amazing... You're amazing...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I wouldn't know. Normally, I couldn't see it.
But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: To think she was running with all those feelings kept inside.
choice_data_list: Good work. That was a nice try.
Good work. That was a nice try.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer... Yeah, today I only caught a glimpse of it, but even so...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I learned so much.
About the sheer intensity of the Umamusume running on dirt...
A heightened sensitivity born from her deep knowledge of feng shui. Deeply moved, tears welled up in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tarumae...

"No words are exchanged. Neither praise nor encouragement.
For this is merely a skirmish. And..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we're rivals on the track.
It's only natural not to get overly cozy—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright, Ricky-chan~?
Did you get an owie somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're so sweet!! Acute, you're the sweetest!!

"...No matter how cutthroat the competition was,
Wonder Acute remained as kind as ever."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"We got totally overwhelmed by their intensity today, huh.
Even so, though—"
choice_data_list: We did get something out of it, didn't we?
We did get something out of it, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And I feel like I understand
the two of them a little better now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, it wasn't just about what I gained—
I left something behind too, if only a little."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because I managed to etch my running, my very presence, just a little into the minds of those two.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"This tiny, invisible mark will surely have an impact.
On the upcoming Champions Cup."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Visible Landform isn't all there is to Feng Shui!
Invisible Qi is Feng Shui too! Look forward to it☆

Her usual cheerful Rickey tone returns.
And so ended the very first race
where all three of them were together.
